questions.question: Ayanda saves R15 each week. Describe the pattern of her savings and find how much she has after week 10.
questions.expected_answer: The pattern is R15, R30, R45, R60, and so on. It starts at 15 and adds 15 each time, which is a constant difference. After week 10 she has 10 times 15, which is R150.

questions.question: Extend 1, 3, 9, 27 by two numbers and describe the rule.
questions.expected_answer: Each number is 3 times the one before, so the pattern has a constant ratio of 3. 27 times 3 is 81, and 81 times 3 is 243. The rule is start at 1 and multiply by 3 each time.

questions.question: Is 2, 4, 8, 16 a constant difference or a constant ratio pattern? Explain.
questions.expected_answer: The differences are 2, 4 and 8, which are not the same, so it is not a constant difference. Each number is double the one before, so it is a constant ratio pattern with ratio 2.
